questions.question:
a) Derive an expression for motor speed in terms of supply voltage, firing angle and motor constants of a single-phase fully controlled. Separately excited dc motor. Draw waveform of supply voltage, armature voltage and current at a fixed speed under continuous conduction. [8]

b) A $400\text{ V}$, star connected, 3-phase, 6 pole, $50\text{ Hz}$ induction motor with parameters referred to the stator are given below: $r_1 = r_2' = 1\text{ }\Omega$ and $x_1 = x_2' = 2\text{ }\Omega$. This motor is to be braked by plugging from initial full load speed of $950\text{ rpm}$. Stator to rotor turn ratio is $2:3$. Find:

i) Calculate the initial braking current and torque as the ratio of their full load values.
ii) What resistance must be inserted in the rotor circuit to reduce the maximum braking current to $1.5$ times full load current? What will be the initial braking torque now?
